children: Magnolia Oil & Gas reported multiple financing actions tied to its WildFire acquisition. The company assumed obligations on $600 million of 7.500% Senior Notes due 2029 via a supplemental indenture and added a subsidiary guarantor. Magnolia also added Magnolia Midstream as a guarantor to its 6.875% notes due 2032 and 6.625% notes due 2034, enhancing creditor protections. In addition, Magnolia granted registration rights to WildFire covering the resale of 32.2 million Magnolia shares issued as part of the deal, including a 30-day lock-up.
Agreement 1: Magnolia Oil & Gas Assumes $600 Million 7.500% 2029 Notes, Adds Guarantor via Supplemental Indenture
: Supplemental indenture and assumption of 7.500% Senior Notes due 2029
: Align WildFire notes with Magnolia’s capital structure
Agreement 2: Magnolia Oil & Gas Adds Magnolia Midstream as Guarantor to 6.875% 2032 Notes
: Supplemental indenture adding guarantor to 6.875% Senior Notes due 2032
: Enhance creditor protections and integrate structure post-acquisition
Agreement 3: Magnolia Oil & Gas Adds Magnolia Midstream as Guarantor to 6.625% 2034 Notes
: Supplemental indenture adding guarantor to 6.625% Senior Notes due 2034
: Strengthen guarantees and align post-acquisition obligations
Agreement 4: Magnolia Oil & Gas Grants Registration Rights on 32.2M Shares Issued in WildFire Acquisition
: Registration rights agreement for resale of equity consideration
: Facilitate orderly resale of acquisition equity consideration
